packages.name: @kiln/workbench
packages.runtime: browser (React 18, single HTML file); node for build and tests
packages.purpose: The Kiln workbench page: a dock of compiler, performance, evidence, jobs, lab-board and agent views over one Workbench singleton; built into one self-contained HTML file that the Kiln server serves.
packages.notes: 27 W-NN presets (.js + .md) in apps/workbench/presets; generated src/*.gen.js and dist/ are gitignored.

packages.name: scripts
packages.purpose: Repo-level tooling used by the workbench: CDP screenshot harness, named view shots, design specimen, WCAG contrast check, dead-CSS finder, kiln-program/1 export, plain-node test runner.

modules.name: workbench build
modules.purpose: Generates presets/labs/docs/worker .gen.js modules, bundles main.jsx and the agent worker with esbuild, concatenates CSS and writes dist/index.html and dist/kiln-workbench.html.

modules.name: page entry
modules.purpose: Mounts <App/>, exposes window.__kiln, switches the agent to the server relay when /api/agent/usage is ready.

modules.name: page compile helpers
modules.purpose: pipelineFor, compileScript, hasKernels, endToEnd: compile a project script against given state; compileScript is used by the agent frame, the helpers by the page too.

modules.name: Kiln server client
modules.purpose: HTTP client for /api/*, SSE subscription with backoff, and the kiln-kernels/1 job spec builders.
modules.key_exports: connectServer; subscribe; jobSpec; jobKernel; EVENT_TYPES; ServerError

modules.name: record sync and host devices
modules.purpose: Debounced record push/pull with the server, HostDevice for server hosts, job list merge helpers.

modules.name: Workbench singleton
modules.purpose: The page's one mutable store: script, compile, params, devices, evidence, hypotheses, measure, compare, tune, server, jobs, presets, layout; named pub/sub channels.
modules.key_exports: wb; lsGet; lsSet; GROUP_ORDER; REFERENCE; GUIDELINES

modules.name: dock layout tree
modules.purpose: Pure operations on the dock tree (tiles and splits), the view-id lists and the four preset layouts.
modules.key_exports: IDE_VIEWS; SYS_VIEWS; ALL_VIEWS; LAYOUTS; isBoardView; normalize; moveToTab; moveToSide; splitTile; closeView; flatViews

modules.name: dock renderer
modules.purpose: Renders the dock: splits with draggable gutters, tab strips, view picker, drag-and-drop with edge hit testing, phone fallback.

modules.name: view registry
modules.purpose: VIEWS map from view id to title, about text, column flag, element and badge; viewDef resolves board:<id> views.

modules.name: app shell
modules.purpose: Top bar (preset menu, save/download/import, layout menu, kernel and time pills), toasts, global shortcuts.

modules.name: UI primitives
modules.purpose: useLab channel hook and the primitive components every view uses.
modules.key_exports: useLab; cls; Btn; Seg; Tog; Pill; Tabs; Kv; Meter; Code; Spark; Menu; Empty

modules.name: provenance marks
modules.purpose: Shared vocabulary for values with provenance (model, simulated, measured), status stamps and the SVG hatch defs.
modules.key_exports: METHOD; Val; StatusStamp; modelOf; modelVal; evidenceVal; optionEvidence; simRef; hwRef; recordVal; valueVal; SvgDefs

modules.name: code and reference panes
modules.purpose: Code view (textarea editor over a highlighted pre, parameter controls, checks) and the Reference view.

modules.name: notes view
modules.purpose: Renders the preset's markdown notes with KaTeX, lab: links and portaled hypothesis cards; edit and save.

modules.name: compiler views
modules.purpose: IR view (pipeline map, step banner, clickable IR text, node side panel), Graph view (own layered layout, 500-node cap) and Trace view (pass steps with diffs).
modules.key_exports: IrView; GraphView; TraceView; IrText; NodeRef; NodeSide; Diff

modules.name: kernels view
modules.purpose: Kernels table (model, measured, validity), content ids and activation, source tabs CUDA/WGSL/Kernel IR/Tile/Loop/Launch; also hosts the shared saveText/copyText helpers.

modules.name: perf, tune and devices views
modules.purpose: Perf view (big number, history, per-kernel model/sim/hw cells, metrics, roofline, across-devices table, compare panel), Tune view with TuneChart, Devices view with protocol and host blocks.

modules.name: knobs view
modules.purpose: Forks table with options, model and measured times, pins and sliders; the shared ParamControl used by the Code view.

modules.name: evidence view
modules.purpose: Evidence records grouped by identity, row or device; import/export/forget; record detail with sample strip.

modules.name: hypotheses view
modules.purpose: Kiln-project hypotheses judged against evidence (supported/refuted/open/unqualified), predicates and per-row judgments; also the card embedded in notes.

modules.name: jobs view
modules.purpose: Server jobs with status stamps, planner verdicts, plan steps, dry runs, detail with archive link; ServerLine for the Devices view.

modules.name: events view
modules.purpose: Workbench log and the last compile's events, filterable by kind.

modules.name: agent panel
modules.purpose: Agent chat: settings, composer, user and assistant messages, tool cards with approval, parts (table/code/proposal), conversation history and export.

modules.name: notes markdown renderer
modules.purpose: Markdown + KaTeX renderer for notes and board text, with lab: links and hypothesis slots; exports inline() used by lab boards.

modules.name: agent answer markdown
modules.purpose: Small markdown renderer for agent answers, separate from doc.js.

modules.name: script highlighter
modules.purpose: Tokeniser/highlighter for the project-script editor.

modules.name: lab: link scheme
modules.purpose: Parses and resolves lab: links in notes to views and selections.

modules.name: design tokens
modules.purpose: Swiss monochrome tokens (Arial, greys, one red accent), light and dark (dark defined twice).

modules.name: base styles
modules.purpose: Element defaults over the tokens.

modules.name: chrome styles
modules.purpose: Top bar and dock chrome.

modules.name: view styles
modules.purpose: Per-view styling for compiler, kernels, perf, knobs, agent and others.

modules.name: evidence styles
modules.purpose: Evidence and hypotheses styling.

modules.name: Labs singleton
modules.purpose: Second store: builds Perf Lab programs from LAB_PROGRAMS over synthetic or server data, tracks params, plans and runs them as jobs; publishes on wb's lab channel.

modules.name: lab client
modules.purpose: Wraps /api/lab/* (catalog, datasets, bundles, media) as @kiln/lab data; turns lab captures into Kiln jobs; re-exports @kiln/lab build/runtime names.
modules.key_exports: labClient; labJobs; serverEnv; syntheticEnv; build; materialize

modules.name: board renderer
modules.purpose: BoardView, ViewRenderer, Panel frame and error boundary; dispatches board panel kinds and layouts.
modules.key_exports: BoardView; ViewRenderer; Panel; useBoard; useResolved; Rich; PanelError

modules.name: board panels (non-chart)
modules.purpose: Table, stat, run list, manifest, manifest diff, hypothesis card, text, note, math, source, control panels; LabVal value cell.
modules.key_exports: TableView; StatView; RunListView; ManifestView; ManifestDiffView; HypothesisCardView; TextView; NoteView; MathView; SourceView; ControlView; LabVal

modules.name: board charts
modules.purpose: Chart, timeline and mirror panels ported from Perf Lab without d3, monochrome with shapes/dashes/hatches.

modules.name: board media panels
modules.purpose: Gallery and detections panels with a detection overlay, ported from Perf Lab.

modules.name: board inspection panels
modules.purpose: Kernel card, route, ledger, stepper and batch panels; MetricsTable.
modules.key_exports: KernelCardView; RouteView; LedgerView; StepperView; BatchView; MetricsTable

modules.name: lab view
modules.purpose: Lab program picker, boards list, hypotheses table, plan with run/dry-run, host reports, runs.

modules.name: inspect view
modules.purpose: Detail of the selected lab entity: fields, relations, metrics, manifest.

modules.name: board param bar
modules.purpose: Board parameters (plan/data/view bound); pending plan when captures are missing.

modules.name: lab board styles

modules.name: agent loop

modules.name: agent sandbox

modules.name: agent worker entry

modules.name: workbench presets

service_calls.description: records: GET/POST/DELETE /api/records (pull, debounced push in chunks of 250, forget)
archives: GET /api/archives and the /api/archives/:sha download link
agent relay: POST /api/agent/sample, NDJSON stream of text deltas and a done event, up to 12 calls per turn
GET /api/events: hello, ping, job.updated, job.event, records.added, device.updated, host.updated, catalog.changed, evidence.registered; backoff 1 s to 30 s
WebGpuDevice runs compiled WGSL kernels in the browser for measure, compare and tune
host bridge window.claude.use('sample') when the page runs as an artifact and the relay is not ready
shoot.mjs drives Chrome over the DevTools protocol to load the built page and screenshot it
kiln-export.mjs imports packages/kiln/src by relative path to compile a preset

complexity_hotspots.reason: God object: script, compile, params, devices, evidence, hypotheses, measure, compare, tune, server, record sync, jobs, presets, layout and toasts in one class; every view and the agent scope reach into it.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Split server/jobs (319-466), devices, and layout into modules behind the channel store.

complexity_hotspots.reason: makeAgentScope (357-537) defines every namespace inline and wraps mutations one by one for read-only mode; AGENT_SCOPE (102-124) hand-documents the same surface and has drifted.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Generate the scope doc from the namespace definitions.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Three dock views (Perf, Tune, Devices) plus Roofline with label placement, compare panel and long single-line JSX rows.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: One file per view; extract Roofline.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Three charts with their own scales, ticks, lanes and legends, written without a charting library.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Shared scale/axis helper; or share Perf Lab's d3 version.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Drag state, edge hit testing, drop preview, gutters and the phone fallback; untested.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Tests for drag/drop on dock.js operations.

complexity_hotspots.reason: IR, Graph and Trace views plus a self-contained layered graph layout in one file.
Top bar with large inline handlers (App.jsx:109 notes download) duplicating saveText.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Use saveText; move menu handlers out.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Second singleton that borrows wb's channel and manipulates the dock tree directly.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Give lab state its own channel and a dock API.

facts.fact: useLab(...channels) subscribes a component to named channels with useSyncExternalStore and returns the wb object.

diagrams.title: Kiln workbench page architecture
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph page[@kiln/workbench page]
    main[main.jsx] --> App[ui/App.jsx]
    App --> Dock[ui/Dock.jsx + dock.js]
    Dock --> Views[views.jsx VIEWS]
    Views --> KilnViews[Notes Code IR Graph Trace Kernels Perf Knobs Tune Evidence Hypotheses Devices Jobs Events]
    Views --> LabViews[Lab Inspect board:id]
    KilnViews --> wb[(wb singleton\nui/wb.js)]
    LabViews --> labs[(labs singleton\nui/lab/state.js)]
    labs -- publishes on lab channel --> wb
    Views --> AgentPanel[ui/Agent.jsx]
    AgentPanel --> agent[agent/agent.js]
    agent --> sandbox[agent/sandbox.js iframe + worker]
  end
  wb --> kiln[@kiln/kiln compiler, std, devices]
  labs --> lab[@kiln/lab]
  wb -- http + sse --> server[@kiln/server]
  labs -- /api/lab/* --> server
  agent -- /api/agent/sample --> server
  agent -- host bridge --> host[claude.ai artifact host]
  kiln -- WebGPU --> gpu[browser GPU]
  server -- jobs --> runner[runner / kiln-perf]

diagrams.title: Kiln workbench agent eval through the sandbox
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant M as model (relay or host bridge)
  participant A as agent.js (page)
  participant F as sandbox iframe + worker (frame.js)
  participant W as wb (page state)
  M->>A: tool_use eval(code)
  A->>A: approval (mode ask/auto/readonly)
  A->>F: runInFrame(code, context) over MessageChannel
  F->>F: compile/check locally (compileScript)
  F->>A: proxied scope call (e.g. params.set)
  A->>W: apply (snapshot first, undoable)
  W-->>A: result
  A-->>F: result (toWire)
